module: Old local UDP server (127.0.0.1:22137) that received the commands of the 'beamng:' URL scheme and passed them to commandhandler.onSchemeCommand. The code is marked OBSOLETE: the default scheme handler is now a Windows pipe.
notes: Only packets starting with 'beamng:' are processed; the 7-character prefix is removed before the call.
Only one packet (4096 bytes max) is read per frame.
onFirstUpdate returns false if the port cannot be opened, but this return value is not used by a hook.

onFirstUpdate.desc: First-update hook: opens the UDP socket 127.0.0.1:22137 (non-blocking). Logs a warning if the opening fails.

returns.desc: false if the socket could not be opened.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: reads a UDP packet; if the text starts with 'beamng:', calls commandhandler.onSchemeCommand with the rest.
